description: Records collection of a physical sample for a specific accession test line item. Unlike the accession status-update endpoints (API-048/API-049), this creates the actual sample_collection record; organizationId and branchId are supplied in the request body rather than the path, consistent with the payment endpoint's convention.

body.sampleCondition: enum, optional, default GOOD - GOOD | HEMOLYZED | CLOTTED | LEAKING | INSUFFICIENT | DAMAGED
body.collectionStatus: enum, optional, default COLLECTED - COLLECTED | RECOLLECTION_REQUIRED | REJECTED

validation: accessionTestId must reference an existing accession test (NOT NULL FK)
accessionTestId must belong to the same organization + branch as the caller
collectorId, if provided, must reference an existing user
sampleCondition, if provided, must be one of GOOD, HEMOLYZED, CLOTTED, LEAKING, INSUFFICIENT, DAMAGED (CHECK)
collectionStatus, if provided, must be one of COLLECTED, RECOLLECTION_REQUIRED, REJECTED (CHECK)
quantity, if provided, must be > 0 - see database_gap note
accessionTestId must not already have a sample_collection record (UNIQUE constraint uq_sample_collection)

errors.condition: accessionTestId does not reference an existing accession test
collectorId does not reference an existing user
sampleCondition is not a recognized value
collectionStatus is not a recognized value
accessionTestId already has a sample_collection record

response.error: Sample already collected for this accession test

errors.condition: accessionTestId exists but does not belong to the caller's organization/branch

constraints: sample_condition NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GOOD' CHECK IN (GOOD, HEMOLYZED, CLOTTED, LEAKING, INSUFFICIENT, DAMAGED)
collection_status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'COLLECTED' CHECK IN (COLLECTED, RECOLLECTION_REQUIRED, REJECTED)
quantity NUMERIC(10,2) - nullable, no CHECK constraint (see database_gap note)

notes: DB GAP: quantity is defined as NUMERIC(10,2) with no CHECK constraint, so quantity = 0 (or negative) is currently accepted by the database (database/api_contracts_test/016_sample_collection.sql TEST 5 confirms the insert succeeds and must be rolled back manually). Per the task's DB GAP rule, the 400 error condition above reflects the INTENDED API behavior, not what the database currently enforces - the database itself needs a CHECK (quantity > 0) added to database/schema/019_sample_collection.sql to actually back this contract. The 404 (invalid accession_test_id/collector), 400 (invalid sample_condition/collection_status), and 409 (duplicate) conditions are all genuinely enforced today via FK and CHECK/UNIQUE constraints.
